verdict.rationale: Phaser is published under the MIT license on npm (probe-rt-1) and its engine source is hosted publicly on GitHub (phaserjs/phaser), so developers can legally read, fork, and modify it. Community commentary critiquing the engine's internal patterns, such as circular dependencies, suggests developers do read the source. The pack shows the license and repo but not the workflow of building a modified engine. Missing for 10: documentation of building or customizing the engine from source, explicit hands-on corroboration of patching or forking the engine.
